name: Klaus-Dieter Ziegler
bio:
Klaus-Dieter's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track but in his grandfather's autobody shop. There, amidst the clang of hammers and the smell of lacquer, he discovered a passion for precision and aesthetics. He honed his skills, mastering the art of achieving flawless finishes and innovative paint schemes. After a decade working in the automotive industry, Klaus-Dieter transitioned to motorsport, drawn by the high stakes and the constant demand for perfection.

His approach is methodical and detail-oriented, always pushing the boundaries of what's possible with paint technology. He sees each car not just as a machine but as a canvas, an opportunity to create a visually stunning masterpiece that reflects the team's identity and spirit. Klaus-Dieter is known for his ability to blend cutting-edge techniques with classic craftsmanship, resulting in finishes that are both durable and eye-catching. His management skills allows him to lead a team of painters effectively, ensuring the highest quality standards are always met.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted to the side with a slight wave
physical.description: Klaus-Dieter is a sturdy man with broad shoulders and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always wears white gloves when inspecting a paint job, even if it's still wet.
Insists on using only German-made polishing cloths.
Carries a small notebook filled with color swatches and paint formulas.
